--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/caching.md
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Response caching
+
+All API responses are served from the cache; the origin is only
+contacted to repopulate it on expiry.
+
+## Probe wiring
+
+/health and /metrics bypass the cache and always hit origin
+services, so probes reflect live state.

note: Isolated defect: unqualified absolute ('All API responses') contradicts the probe bypass documented in the same file.
